name: media-processing
description: Media processing skills that let the agent watch a video: downloads with yt-dlp, extracts auto-scaled frames with ffmpeg, pulls captions or falls back to Whisper, and hands frames + transcript to the model so it can answer questions about the video.

interface.shortDescription: 粘贴视频链接或本地路径，让智能体观看视频并回答内容问题。
interface.longDescription: media-processing 提供 watch 技能，让智能体观看任意视频：用 yt-dlp 下载、ffmpeg 抽取自适应画面帧、优先取平台字幕（缺失时回退 Whisper API 转写），再把画面帧与时间戳转写稿交给模型，回答基于视频画面和音频内容的问题。
defaultPrompt: /watch https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ what happens at the 30 second mark?
